licenseBasis: Owner-supplied Meshy output; conservative free-plan attribution path used elsewhere in this repository
conversionRuntime: Three.js FBXLoader; no runtime Blender dependency
conversion: Validated one closed manifold mesh per FBX with no rig, animation, texture, UV, or material dependency
Centered the authored cross-section and normalized full source length to one unit
Clipped only at conservative measured stretch boundaries and preserved the complete source surface
Encoded generated Float32 position/normal buffers as synchronous base64 data
Derived one boundary-tapered relative shaft-thickness morph from the measured source blend widths
Closed and validated the pinned shaft boundary rings during import and derived each morph's quadratic volume polynomial
Solved that polynomial for volume-preserving animation/design composition whenever the fixed boundary collars make a physical solution possible; guarded impossible combined extremes before inversion
Allowed explicit 1.00-1.62 uniform knob enlargement as a separate authoring layer; pinned Ivory Bone's distal endpoint and excluded every Rattle insertion tip
Kept proximal and distal source regions rigid during longitudinal deformation
Did not redistribute the original FBX files or expiring Meshy URLs
